_description: Single source of truth for the default model used by agent-creation scripts. Update by hand (or as part of a /mcs-sync TAKE on the knowledge-cache card for models.md) when MS releases a newer experimental/preview model. Last verified against knowledge/cache/models.md.

fallback_if_experimental_disabled.availability: Europe + US natively; Preview cross-geo elsewhere

_notes: ExperimentalModels: requires admin enablement (experimental + external + cross-geo flags). NOT for prod.
CurrentModels: stable kinds — Preview and GA models.

Always pair with optInUseLatestModels: true so the agent floats forward as MS releases new versions.
